newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray unit to make engineering plastic compounds.
newsitem.headline: Toray unit to make engineering plastic compounds.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Monday that its unit Toray Nylon Thai Co Ltd would begin producing and selling engineering plastic compounds from February 1998.

It said Toray Nylon, which currently produces nylon filament and polyester filament, would invest 700 million yen in two manufacturing lines, one for nylon resin and the other for polybutylene terephthalate (PBT) resin compounds.
The combined monthly production of nylon resin and PBT would be 500 tonnes, it said.
Toray said the products would be sold mainly to Japanese manufacturers in Thailand, Malaysia and other Asian countries.
Toray Nylon is owned 45 percent by Toray and 25.9 percent by Luckytex (Thailand) Ltd, Toray said.
